content:
Priya R: Heads-up — quarterly access review showed ~40 admin entitlements with no owner recorded. Also saw some KMS grants that appear to have persisted after we removed bindings from the IAM sync. Need a quick triage and a deadman fallback plan for apps that could break. Can folks look today? @oncall-bot

Darren: On it. Can you paste the exact query you used to find the KMS grants?

Priya R: Sure — ran a quick bigquery dump, snippet below:
```sql
SELECT resource, grantee, grant_time
FROM `audit_logs.kms_grants`
WHERE grant_time >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
  AND resource LIKE '%projects/redwood-%'
ORDER BY grant_time DESC
LIMIT 200;
```

Alex G: I can repro the persisted grant for svcacct:analytics-svc. Looks like the IAM-sync job ignores bindings that used the legacy role alias. We'll need to update the filter and re-run a cleanup.

Samir K: For a deadman fallback: propose issuing a per-namespace short-lived fallback key that apps can use if their primary grant disappears. Rotation daily by cron, decryption-only scope, and immediate alert if fallback is used. Keeps downtime low while we fix owner issues.

Maria S: Fallback keys are fine but they're high-risk. We need KMS audit log hooks + strict decrypt ACLs. Also the runbook should state: if fallback key used > 1 hour escalate to oncall and open an incident.

Priya R: Agree on escalation thresholds. For the ownerless entitlements, propose auto-creating tickets to the ownerless-admins queue and tagging as "pending-lock". If no owner assigned within 7 days auto-apply a temporary lock and notify product/security.

Darren: Started a staging canary for the cleanup script. Dry-run command I used:
```
python tools/admin_prune.py --dry-run --filter "role:admin AND owner:NULL"
```
Result: 23 candidate bindings in staging, none removed yet.

Samir K: We should add metrics before mass cleanup: ownerless_count (gauge), fallback_key_issued (counter), kms_grant_persisted_count (gauge). Push to telemetry and set a critical alert at >50 ownerless.

audit-bot: Reminder — quarterly_access_review due in 5 days. See https://redwood/tools/access-review :bell:

Priya R: :thumbsup: I'll draft a short runbook (detection -> fallback -> lock -> escalation). Also a one-paragraph note for product owners explaining temporary lock behavior. Can someone own the PR for the sync fix? @Alex G

Alex G: I'll take the PR and land the updated IAM-sync filter. Will run cleanup canary, post results here. :eyes:

Maria S: I'll draft the runbook text and add KMS policy examples (restrict decrypt to specific service principals, add audit log forwarding).

Priya R: Thanks all. Quick async sync in 30 to confirm canary results and runbook acceptance. I'll post the Zoom link.

oncall-bot: oncall rotation: Sarah oncall from 13:00–21:00 UTC. If this escalates, ping @Sarah.

Darren: FYI — opened ticket #SEC-4921 for the ownerless automation plan. Linking it to the access-review board.

Priya R: Perfect. We'll close the loop after the staging run.
